## Problem and evidence
Who experiences this? How often? Attach redacted source/interview/experiment.

## Status
- [ ] Founder-approved product scope
- [ ] Research hypothesis only
- [ ] Blocked on decision

## Proposed behavior
Inputs, outputs, user action, exceptions and non-goals.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Concrete observable behavior
- [ ] Unknown SKU/ambiguous quantity behavior (if relevant)
- [ ] Tenant and permission behavior
- [ ] Human review / no unauthorized actions
- [ ] Offline tests / cost limitations

## Dependencies / risks
Include links to docs, privacy or platform permissions and suggested milestone.
